metadata.title: Sun-Dappled Portrait with Geometric and Script Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A high-contrast portrait framed by a thick black border, featuring dramatic palm leaf shadows across the subject and a mix of ultra-wide geometric sans-serif and expressive white script.
excludeWhen: only a single font style is desired

recipe.visualDefinition: A centered female portrait set against a dark wall, characterized by sharp, organic shadows from foliage. The image is encased in a heavy black square frame. The top margin contains widely spaced, thin geometric capitals, while the right side features a diagonal, fluid white script.
coreVisualRelationships: Contrast between the rigid black frame and the organic shadow patterns
Juxtaposition of formal geometric typography and informal handwriting
Warm skin tones against a deep black background
Diagonal flow of the script echoing the angle of the shadows
coreInvariants: Thick black outer border framing the central image
Organic leaf-shaped shadows cast across the subject's face and body
White text color for all typographic elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Medium close-up portrait, centered horizontally, filling the lower two-thirds of the inner frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's face, specifically the eye caught in the light between shadows.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the wide header text, moves down to the face, then follows the script on the right side.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Heavy black border provides significant structural negative space; dark wall provides internal negative space.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Warm skin tones and golden hair
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between deep shadows and bright highlights; natural skin saturation.

letterConstructionRules: Header: Ultra-thin strokes, circular 'O' and 'C', extremely wide letter spacing.
Script: Fluid, monolinear, connected cursive with long entry and exit strokes.
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'A' in the header has a low crossbar.
The script 'H' has a large, expressive loop.

composition.relationshipToImage: placed in the top black border
floating over the dark background area

typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Extreme contrast between rigid, wide geometric caps and fluid, angled handwriting.

preserve: Wide tracking of the top text
avoid: Heavy bold weights for the header

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the geometric circularity and thin weight of the header.
Captures the personal, handwritten feel of the secondary text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a portrait of a woman with long blonde hair, centered, with sharp palm leaf shadows cast across her face and chest. The background is a dark, textured wall. Frame the entire image with a thick, solid black square border.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the primary title in the top black border using a thin, ultra-wide geometric sans-serif in white. Add the secondary title on the right side of the image area in a white, fluid, hand-written script tilted upwards at a 15-degree angle.

verificationChecks: Is the top text centered and extremely wide?
Are the palm shadows sharp and clearly defined?
Is the script text tilted and overlapping the image area?
Is the black border thick and consistent?

mustRedesign: Do not use soft, diffused lighting
Ensure the script does not look like a standard computer font

mustAchieve: Balanced use of negative space in the frame

postGenerationChecks: Check that the white text is legible against both the black border and the shadowed image.
Verify the geometric 'O's are perfectly circular.
Ensure the script feels like a single continuous motion.
Confirm the shadows do not obscure the subject's features too much.
recipe.reuseFormula: Portrait + Organic Shadow Overlay + Thick Black Frame + (Wide Geometric Header + Angled Script Overlay)
